Marco Li: quick Q  I'm going on parental leave unpaid from 2026-04-01 to 2026-07-31. Do PTO carryover rules still apply? I have ~40h I'd like to carry past the year cutoff.
Alexa (People Ops): hi Marco  short answer: maybe. It depends on leave type and timing. Can you confirm FTE during the leave and whether leave is unpaid vs company-paid parental?
Marco Li: unpaid. I'm switching to 0.5 FTE pay during the leave (manager signed LOA).
Alexa (People Ops): ok that helps. Our standard carryover cap is 80 hours and cutoff is 2026-01-01 -> 2026-12-31 year. For LOA/parental we have an exception flow if the LOA started before the blackout cutoff and manager provides signed approval. We can make a manual carryover beyond cap up to 80 additional hours in one-off cases.
Marco Li: is there a form? what's the process? need to plan for returning Aug 1 and using some PTO in Sept.
Sam (People Ops): @Marco Li we need 2 things: (1) manager confirmation in writing (email or slack ok), (2) submit a "Carryover Exception" ticket in the HR portal with LOA start/end + FTE% and attach the manager approval. We then route to payroll to adjust balances before year-end.
Linda Chen: confirmed  I approved Marco's LOA in the LOA doc on 3/18. happy to add a short note in the ticket.
Marco Li: thanks Linda. quick question: are there any product-launch blackout dates where we can't be on PTO? we're in the middle of the GA launch window in May so want to avoid conflicts.
Alexa (People Ops): FYI GA launch blackout for full-time critical contributors is 2026-05-10 -> 2026-05-22. It's a soft blackout for non-critical roles. If you're on leave during that window it's fine, but if you're returning around then and planning time off, loop your manager first.
Marco Li: understood. I'll plan to return 8/1 and take 8 hours the week of 9/6.
Sam (People Ops): tagging hr-bot to create a placeholder ticket so we don't lose this.
hr-bot: Ticket created: HR-4521. Please update with manager approval and LOA docs. Link: https://hr.example.com/tickets/HR-4521
Marco Li: added Linda's approval screenshot to HR-4521.
Alexa (People Ops): got it  I reviewed docs. We'll approve a 40h carryover as an LOA exception (manual adjustment) provided payroll processes it before year-end. Expect final confirmation by 2026-12-15.
Linda Chen: thanks all, noted in my calendar. :thumbsup:
Marco Li: awesome, thanks folks! :pray:
